# Editorial Design System v2.0 (`hyoword`)

`15_Word-Auto-Skill` upgrades the legacy Hyosung Word template (`Word Template_Empty_No Project Data.docx`) into an executive-grade engineering editorial system while preserving the official embedded Hyosung corporate logo (`word/media/image1.png`, `image2.png`) and header/footer relationships.

---

## 1. Page Geometry (A4 Exact Twips)

| Parameter | Portrait | Landscape |
|-----------|----------|-----------|
| Page Size | `210.0 mm × 297.0 mm` (`11906 × 16838 twips`) | `297.0 mm × 210.0 mm` (`16838 × 11906 twips`) |
| Top / Bottom Margin | `20.0 mm` (`1134 twips`) | `20.0 mm` (`1134 twips`) |
| Left Margin | `20.0 mm` (`1134 twips`) | `20.0 mm` (`1134 twips`) |
| Right Margin | `15.0 mm` (`851 twips`) | `15.0 mm` (`851 twips`) |
| **Printable Content Width** | **`175.0 mm` (`9921 twips`)** | **`262.0 mm` (`14853 twips`)** |
| Header / Footer Distance | `15.0 mm` / `10.0 mm` | `15.0 mm` / `10.0 mm` |

Every table generated by `hyoword` sets `w:tblLayout="fixed"`, explicit `w:tblGrid/w:gridCol`, and explicit cell `w:tcW` summing to `175.0 mm` (Portrait) or `262.0 mm` (Landscape).

---

## 2. Typography Profiles & Legacy Font Purge

All legacy fonts from the donor template (`바탕`, `굴림`, `Times New Roman`, `MS PGothic`, `Trebuchet MS`) are stripped from `styles.xml`, `numbering.xml`, and all generated runs.

| Profile | Primary Use Case | Latin (`ascii`/`hAnsi`) | East Asian (`eastAsia`) | Monospace (`mono`) |
|---------|------------------|-------------------------|-------------------------|--------------------|
| **`epc-en`** / **`global-en`** *(Default for EN)* | Global EPC & engineering projects (North America, Europe, MENA, APAC/Australia, Global Client deliverables): RFI responses, claims, specs, contract reviews | `Arial` | `맑은 고딕` | `Consolas` |
| **`modern`** / **`kr-modern`** *(Default for KO)* | Korean domestic projects (KEPCO/KPX/GenCos/IPPs) & HQ Korean technical review memos, TF reports, executive briefs (Mode A & Mode B) | `Pretendard` | `Pretendard` | `Consolas` |
| **`safe`** | Cross-PC external sharing where Pretendard may not be installed | `Arial` | `맑은 고딕` | `Courier New` |

---

## 3. Typographic Scale & Heading Hierarchy

| Element | Size | Weight | Color | Spacing (`before` / `after` / `line`) | Pagination Rule |
|---------|------|--------|-------|---------------------------------------|-----------------|
| Cover Hero Title | `24.5 pt` | Bold | `#14141F` | `4pt` / `12pt` / `1.18x` | `keepNext` |
| Mode B Banner Title | `16.5 pt` | Bold | `#14141F` | `4pt` / `2pt` / `1.15x` | `keepNext` |
| **Heading 1 (`1.`)** | `14.5 pt` | Bold | `#2E008B` (Deep Purple) + bottom rule `#D8D8E8` | `16pt` / `6pt` / `1.15x` | `keepNext`, `outlineLvl=0` |
| **Heading 2 (`1.1`)** | `12.0 pt` | Bold | `#6428E6` (Main Purple) | `13pt` / `4.5pt` / `1.15x` | `keepNext`, `outlineLvl=1` |
| **Heading 3 (`1.1.1`)** | `10.8 pt` | Bold | `#262633` (Charcoal) | `10pt` / `3pt` / `1.15x` | `keepNext`, `outlineLvl=2` |
| **Heading 4 (`1.1.1.1`)** | `10.2 pt` | Bold | `#646478` (Muted Slate) | `8pt` / `2.5pt` / `1.15x` | `keepNext` |
| Lead Paragraph | `10.8 pt` | Regular | `#14141F` | `2pt` / `6pt` / `1.22x` | Standard |
| Body Paragraph | `10.2 pt` | Regular | `#262633` | `1pt` / `5.5pt` / `1.22x` | Standard |
| Table Header | `8.8 pt` | Bold | `#FFFFFF` (on `#2E008B`) or `#2E008B` (on `#EBE6FF`) | `2pt` / `2pt` / `1.10x` | `w:tblHeader`, `w:cantSplit` |
| Table Body | `8.8–9.0 pt` | Regular / Bold key | `#262633` | `1.5pt` / `1.5pt` / `1.15x` | `w:cantSplit` |
| Table Caption (`표 1.` / `Table 1.`) | `9.0 pt` | Bold | `#2E008B` label + `#646478` title | `8pt` / `3pt` / `1.12x` | `keepNext` |
| Table Note / Source | `8.0 pt` | Regular | `#646478` | `2.5pt` / `6pt` / `1.12x` | `keepLines` |

## 4. Brand & Semantic Color Palette

| Token | Hex | Role |
|-------|-----|------|
| `deep_purple` | `#2E008B` | Primary brand accent, H1 headings, solid table headers, top/bottom table rules |
| `main_purple` | `#6428E6` | H2 headings, sub-clause markers, `++inserted++` redline text |
| `soft_lavender` | `#EBE6FF` | Soft-tint table header fill, `++inserted++` redline fill |
| `royal_blue` | `#0055B8` | Draft response callout bar, informational badges |
| `dark_ink` | `#14141F` | Cover hero title, running header title |
| `charcoal` | `#262633` | Primary body copy and table cell text |
| `slate_muted` | `#646478` | Captions, footnotes, secondary labels, running footer |
| `soft_canvas` | `#F6F5FC` | First-column key cell fill, executive summary callout fill |
| `zebra_row` | `#F9F9FC` | Alternating table row background |
| `border_light` | `#D8D8E8` | Hairline inner horizontal borders (`0.5pt`), running header frame |
| `pass_bg` / `pass_fg` | `#E6F4EA` / `#137333` | `COMPLIANT`, `CLOSED`, `VERIFIED`, `PASS`, `준수`, `완료` |
| `warn_bg` / `warn_fg` | `#FEF7E0` / `#B06000` | `OPEN`, `HOLD`, `PENDING`, `TBC`, `CLARIFICATION`, `보류`, `확인 필요` |
| `fail_bg` / `fail_fg` | `#FCE8E6` / `#C5221F` | `NON-COMPLIANT`, `REJECTED`, `FAIL`, `OVERDUE`, `미준수`, `불가` |
